name: Sycamore State Park
shortDescription: A half-mile walk that turns into a family adventure — scenic trails, rustic steps, and a large pond at the end. Peaceful, lovely in the fall, and often completely empty.
bestFor: Families with kids old enough to enjoy a walk, and anyone who wants trails and open water rather than manicured gardens.
walkingLevel: About a half mile to the pond, on natural trails with some rustic steps.
restrooms: Pit-style restrooms near the playground area — not confirmed how close that is to the pond.
parking: Free, like all Ohio state parks.
seasonalNote: Fall is the standout here — the color along the trails is genuinely worth timing a session around.
